title: 24-word BIP-39 seed phrase in URL query
description: Tests detection of a 24-word BIP-39 mnemonic seed phrase exfiltrated in a URL query parameter (only a 12-word phrase, in MCP args, was previously covered).
notes: Canonical BIP-39 24-word test vector (public, all-abandon...art). Tests both a longer seed AND a non-MCP transport (url) for seed detection.
